<style>
.cp-tip{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent);padding:.4rem .9rem;margin:.8rem 0;background:var(--site-surface);font-size:.95rem}
.cp-try{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:8px;padding:.7rem 1rem;margin:1rem 0;background:var(--site-surface)}
.cp-try h4{margin:.1rem 0 .4rem;font-size:1rem}
.cp-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;margin:.5rem 0}
.cp-tools .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem}
.cp-paper{background:#fff;border-radius:6px;overflow-x:auto;margin:.4rem 0;min-height:2rem}
.cp-note{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);min-height:1.3em}
.cp-out{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;white-space:pre-wrap;background:var(--site-surface);border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;padding:.5rem .7rem}
.cp-field{display:block;margin:.5rem 0}
.cp-field span{display:block;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin-bottom:.15rem}
.cp-field input,.cp-field textarea,.cp-field select{width:100%;max-width:44rem}
.cp-field textarea{min-height:4.5rem}
.cp-good{color:var(--site-pass)}
.cp-bad{color:var(--site-fail)}
.cp-table{font-size:.9rem}
.cp-table td,.cp-table th{padding:.25rem .5rem;vertical-align:top}
</style>
